what: Advanced Energy makes precision power supplies: the units that deliver exactly controlled electrical power to the plasma chambers in chipmaking equipment, and to medical, industrial and data centre systems.
customers: Semiconductor equipment makers, data centre operators, medical device makers and industrial manufacturers.
money: plasma power supplies and matching networks
power supplies for servers and AI racks
precision power for industrial and medical equipment
moat: Power supplies designed into a chipmaking tool are qualified with it, and changing them would require requalifying the whole process.
risks: Free cash flow of only $70M against $289M of net income, because inventory and capacity are being funded
Revenue depends on semiconductor capital spending, which is cyclical
opportunities: Revenue recovered from $1.5B to $1.8B last year
Analysts see about 83% upside, with 12 covering the stock
AI server racks need far more sophisticated power delivery than earlier servers, which is a new and growing market
watch: Data centre computing revenue and semiconductor segment orders.
